title: EloDisplay
description: Displays players PVP Tiers next to their name (FlowPVP Elo system)
body:
## Elo Display
A non official mod that displays the Elo of a player from FlowPVP Ranked.
![FlowPVP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a4386c896fe7fc4472c205abbcb3efedb9bdfbf.png)
Not affiliated with flowpvp.gg

_______________________________________________________________________________________
Note: Mod Menu and Fabric are required.

EloDisplay is a Fabric Mod that displays the Elo rating of a player by their username, supports all Gamemodes and even has unique options for showing average and best elo. If a player is unranked in the specific gamemode selected gamemode it wont show up.
